title: 2026-10-22_Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_Scenario_7f7
description: Investigate and identify the source of unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to proceed.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to proceed.

levels.title: Identify Unauthorized Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.
levels.solution: Check running services and their network connections. Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all services and identify the unauthorized one.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and their network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all services.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Traffic Service
levels.content: Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.
levels.solution: Examine network connections and service logs for unusual activity. Use the command 'ss -tulnp' to list all network connections and identify the service generating abnormal traffic.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine network connections and service logs for unusual activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'ss -tulnp' to list all network connections.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for connections to external IPs or unusual ports.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.
levels.solution: Investigate system startup configurations and scheduled tasks. Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all systemd timers and identify the persistence mechanism.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate system startup configurations and scheduled tasks.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all systemd timers.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for timers that trigger the suspicious service.
